notes: Cai dat: tai file HPCONS-BIM-Setup-1.75.0.exe ben duoi, DONG Revit roi chay (can quyen Admin). - Tick 'Nha xe tang 1 ho bien: xe vao truc tiep tu NGOAI' (muc 3. Huong hang xe): dai sat bien khong can loi di ben trong, o dat sat mep hang muc; dai ke ben trong van quay vao loi di trong. - Mau dai co them dang 'xe-xe-loi di-xe-xe-...-xe-xe' (2 dai ngoai cung tua bien), dai hep chi 1-2 hang deu vao tu ngoai. Vi du hang muc 15 x 7 m: 35 xe -> 42 xe; 40 x 12 m: 182 -> 195 xe. - Bao cao + ghi chu ghi ro so xe dau tu bien ngoai. Chi tick khi bien hang muc la mai che/khung ho, khong tuong bao.
